note: Curated tool map for Agent Zero v2. Hand-written: the short route to every program and function. Paths verified against apitests/routes.json and the live url_map on 2026-10-08. Risk: read = no side effects; act = changes state, runs freely but is logged; danger = destructive or costly, needs the operator's confirmation.
